target_contract.split_use: Use all 247 rows for both routes; score only the 233 scored rows; retain the 14 audit rows separately. Holdout is never used for route tuning, syntax repair, parameter selection or threshold changes.
target_contract.external_data_use: No external baseline current, teacher spreadsheet or literature curve may replace or augment the frozen project rows.

device_contract.equations: Only the frozen M00 R02 teaching kernel is evaluated through two simulator routes; no TCAD, trap, contact, temperature, HZO or circuit equation is added.

port_mapping.reported_current: absolute drain current divided by W, in A/cm, with one sign convention for both routes

ngspice_behavioral.route_kind: ngspice behavioral equivalent evaluation of the frozen M00 teaching kernel
ngspice_behavioral.allowed_claim: A separately executed ngspice behavioral route against frozen IGZO teaching targets; not native HSPICE Level 61, physical parameter extraction or experimental calibration.

xyce_source_behavioral.route_kind: pure-source Xyce B-level 1 expression evaluation of the same frozen M00 teaching kernel
xyce_source_behavioral.expression_source_type: B-level 1 expression-based voltage or current source
xyce_source_behavioral.allowed_claim: A separately executed pure-open-source Xyce evaluation of the frozen IGZO teaching-kernel text; not native AIM-Spice Level 15, HSPICE Level 61, physical calibration or equation identity.

xyce_source_provenance.dependency_policy: Trilinos and other build dependencies must be recorded by package/version/hash before a binary is admitted; Sandia XyceNF binaries with proprietary models are not accepted for this pure-open-source route.

reviewed_capabilities: limit(...) token and three-argument parser production
.func user-defined functions in official test netlists
B-level 1 expression-based voltage or current source
batch positional netlist syntax, -l log path and -o output basename

batch_contract.netlist_policy: Generate one device-only DC netlist per route after the tool/build preflight; include only the frozen candidate, source/drain and two gate bias sources, one DC analysis and explicit CSV print columns.
batch_contract.xyce_cli_source_basis: Xyce source N_IO_CmdParse.C usage and option registration; exact built-binary fingerprint and -syntax self-test are mandatory before device execution.
required_preflight_self_tests: source archive and build provenance hash

metric_contract.aggregate_weighting: Equal weight per complete scored curve; train and holdout separate; audit rows excluded from scored aggregates.
metric_contract.route_difference: Every frozen row and curve gets absolute and logarithmic ngspice-to-Xyce differences; disagreement is diagnostic and not a tunable pass threshold.
metric_contract.threshold_policy: Do not retune candidates or alter frozen targets to meet M00 descriptive thresholds.

excluded_assets: all SnO files and P-type assets
circuit, transient, ring oscillator and full-adder netlists
external baseline currents and teacher spreadsheet values
proprietary XyceNF or unauthorized AIM-Spice binaries

evidence_boundary: This is an E3 static recovery contract only. It preserves the historical M01 revision-3 E3 contract and the R01 11/13 E0/FAIL AIM-Spice provenance failure without reinterpreting either as numerical evidence. The active replacement routes are ngspice and a pure-source GPL Xyce build; the unauthorized AIM-Spice copy and proprietary XyceNF binaries are excluded. Xyce source review establishes syntax capability only; no Xyce binary, device netlist, SPICE numerical curve, route comparison, physical parameter, physical calibration, experimental calibration or circuit result is created here. The same frozen IGZO teaching-kernel text is mapped to both routes, but equation identity is not claimed and the replacement is not native AIM-Spice Level 15 or HSPICE Level 61. M01 stays E0/FAIL until a committed build/tool preflight, two device-only DC runs and an independent persisted-evidence check pass. P3, P5, C00, SPICE circuit work, layout, PEX and HZO remain closed.
next_gate: Implement and commit the pure-source Xyce build/tool preflight and self-test chain; do not execute a device netlist until that chain passes.
